text: Hi, I'm messaging for my little brother, he's 11, our mum's on a night shift. He's got chickenpox, itchy spots mostly on his back and tummy, but he's fine otherwise. He's had a temperature on and off today. We've been giving him paracetamol and ibuprofen like the box says and in between doses he's still playing on his console, drinking plenty and chatting away. Just wanted to check that's all normal for chickenpox and if there's anything we should be doing for the itching.
